messages.content: can you find the bakery navigating the game?

text:
I'll help you find the bakery! Let me start by looking around to get oriented in the game world.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="send_action">
<parameter name="action">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="send_action">
<parameter name="action">exits</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me wait a moment for the output to come through, then explore the area systematically to find the bakery.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="send_action">
<parameter name="action">look</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Once I get the initial description, I'll start exploring different directions to map out the world and locate the bakery. Can you let me know what the output shows? Or would you like me to continue exploring by trying different movement directions like "north," "south," "east," and "west" to find the bakery?
